title: Nazca: AI helps discover 303 new figurative geoglyphs
summary: An IBM model flagged 1,309 candidates; about a quarter were ground-checked over roughly six months, finding 303 new figurative geoglyphs among 430 already known and increasing the discovery rate 16-fold. Another 968 candidates remain to be checked; the study had been accepted by PNAS at the time of the announcement.

evidence.tested: Field teams ground-checked about a quarter of the 1,309 AI-flagged candidates on foot over roughly six months, finding 303 new figurative geoglyphs.
evidence.unknown: 968 candidates remain unsurveyed, training data was limited, and the study was accepted but not yet published in PNAS at the time of the announcement.
evidence.ai_role: An IBM model that works with few training samples analyzed aerial geospatial imagery to flag likely geoglyph areas.
